EllipsizeType
enum

EllipsizeType

Package:dji.open.pilot.base.ui.model

Text truncation type enumeration. When the text exceeds maxLines, it controls how the excess part is displayed.

Enum Members

NameDescription
UNKNOWNUnknown (no truncation is set; the text is cropped directly when it overflows).
STARTTruncate at the beginning of the text, replaced by an ellipsis (…text).
MIDDLETruncate in the middle of the text, replaced by an ellipsis (te…xt).
ENDTruncate at the end of the text, replaced by an ellipsis (text…).
MARQUEEMarquee effect; the text scrolls for display.

InputType

Package:dji.open.pilot.base.ui.model

EditText keyboard input type enumeration, corresponding to the Android InputType constants. It determines the type of soft keyboard popped up and the input restrictions.

Enum Members

NameDescription
UNKNOWNUnknown (default; uses the system default input type).
TEXTNormal text input (default text keyboard).
TEXT_MULTI_LINEMulti-line text input.
NUMBERInteger number input (numeric keyboard).
NUMBER_DECIMALNumeric input with a decimal point.
NUMBER_SIGNEDNumeric input that can include a sign (plus or minus).
PHONEPhone number input (dial pad keyboard).
EMAIL_ADDRESSEmail address input (text keyboard with the @ symbol).
PASSWORDPassword input (text content masked with dots).
NUMBER_PASSWORDNumeric password input (numbers only, masked with dots).

RemoteViewProperty
enum

RemoteViewProperty

Package:dji.open.pilot.base.ui.model

Remote view property enumeration (defines the types of view properties that can be dynamically modified).

Enum Members

NameDescription
UNKNOWNUnknown property type (default value or undefined property).
TEXTText content property (applicable to text controls such as TextView / Button / EditText).
BACKGROUND_COLORBackground color property (ARGB format color value).
WEB_VIEW_URLWebView loading address (specifies the URL of the web page to render).
PROGRESSProgress value property (sets the current progress percentage of components such as ProgressBar).
IMAGEImage resource property (sets the bitmap or resource ID of an ImageView).
TEXT_SIZEText size (unit: sp).
TEXT_COLORText color.
EDIT_TEXT_CURSOR_POSITIONCursor position.
GRAVITYText alignment.
FONT_STYLE_TYPEFont style enumeration.
SCALE_TYPEImage fill mode.
VERTICAL_SCROLLABLEWhether the text supports vertical scrolling. Effective only for TextView-type controls.
EDIT_TEXT_HINTThe hint text of the EditText.
EDIT_TEXT_GROUPINGEditText grouping.
SPINNER_ITEMSSpinner item list (each item is separated using RemoteView.ITEMS_SEPARATOR).
SPINNER_SELECTED_INDEXThe index of the currently selected item in the spinner.
SPINNER_DROPDOWN_BG_COLORBackground color of the dropdown list popup layer (ARGB format).
SPINNER_DROPDOWN_TEXT_COLORFont color of the dropdown list items (ARGB format).
CHECKEDThe checked state (true / false) of a CompoundButton (CheckBox / Switch / ToggleButton). Effective only for CHECK_BOX / SWITCH / TOGGLE_BUTTON.
VISIBILITYControl visibility (VISIBLE / INVISIBLE / GONE). Applicable to all controls.
ENABLEDControl enabled/disabled state (true / false). Applicable to all controls; once disabled, the control is non-interactive and shows a disabled style.
PADDINGControl padding, in the format "left,top,right,bottom" (unit dp). Applicable to all controls.
MAX_LINESMaximum number of text lines to display (positive integer). Effective only for TEXT_VIEW / BUTTON / EDIT_TEXT.
ELLIPSIZEText truncation method, effective when maxLines is exceeded. The value uses the value string of the EllipsizeType enum. Effective only for TEXT_VIEW / BUTTON / EDIT_TEXT.
INPUT_TYPEEditText keyboard input type (text / number / password / email, etc.). The value uses the value string of the InputType enum. Effective only for EDIT_TEXT.
MAX_LENGTHMaximum number of input characters for the EditText (positive integer). Effective only for EDIT_TEXT.
PROGRESS_MAXThe maximum value of the ProgressBar (positive integer, default 100). Effective only for PROGRESS_BAR.
BACKGROUND_SHAPEBackground shape style. Applicable to all controls.
LIST_DATAFull list data (JSON array format). Effective only for VERTICAL_LIST_VIEW.
LIST_INSERT_ITEMInsert a single item of data into the list (JSON format, containing the position and item data). Effective only for VERTICAL_LIST_VIEW.
LIST_REMOVE_ITEMRemove a single item of data from the list (the value is the position string). Effective only for VERTICAL_LIST_VIEW.
LIST_UPDATE_ITEMUpdate a single item of data in the list (JSON format, containing the position and item data). Effective only for VERTICAL_LIST_VIEW.
LIST_DIVIDER_CONFIGList divider configuration (JSON format, containing height/color/paddingLeft/paddingRight/showLastDivider). Effective only for VERTICAL_LIST_VIEW.
LIST_ITEM_CLICK_ENABLEDWhether the list item click event is enabled ("true"/"false"). Effective only for VERTICAL_LIST_VIEW.
PROGRESS_COLORProgress bar color (ARGB format integer). Effective only for progress bars.
PROGRESS_TEXT_SIZEThe center text size of the circular progress bar (unit: sp, positive integer). Effective only for CIRCULAR_PROGRESS_BAR.
PROGRESS_STATUSCircular progress bar status (normal / success / failure). The value uses the value string of the ProgressStatusType enum. When in the SUCCESS / FAIL state, the center hides the text and shows the corresponding icon. Effective only for CIRCULAR_PROGRESS_BAR.
ALPHAControl opacity (float, range 0.0 ~ 1.0; 0.0 is fully transparent, 1.0 is fully opaque). Applicable to all controls.
SINGLE_LINESingle-line text mode ("true" / "false"). Effective only for TEXT_VIEW / BUTTON / EDIT_TEXT.
LINE_SPACINGText line spacing, in JSON format {"extra":float,"multiplier":float}. extra is in dp (additional spacing), and multiplier is the line spacing multiple. Example: {"extra":4.0,"multiplier":1.2}. Effective only for TEXT_VIEW / BUTTON.
TEXT_DECORATIONText decoration (underline, strikethrough). The value uses the value string of the TextDecorationType enum. Effective only for TEXT_VIEW / BUTTON.
HINT_TEXT_COLOREditText hint text color (ARGB format integer). Effective only for EDIT_TEXT.
SWITCH_THUMB_COLORSwitch thumb color (ARGB format integer). Effective only for SWITCH.
SWITCH_TRACK_COLORSwitch track color (ARGB format integer). Effective only for SWITCH.
CHECKBOX_TINTCheckBox check box tint (ARGB format integer). Unchecked state: the border changes to the target color; checked state: both the border and fill change to the target color, and the check mark remains white. Effective only for CHECK_BOX.
MIN_SIZEControl minimum size, in the format "minWidth,minHeight" (unit dp). Applicable to all controls.
LETTER_SPACINGText letter spacing (float, unit em; e.g. 0.1 means adding 0.1em spacing between each character). Effective only for TEXT_VIEW / BUTTON.
IMAGE_TINTImageView image tint (ARGB format integer). Commonly used for icon color switching. Effective only for IMAGE_VIEW.
SPINNER_SELECTED_TEXT_COLORThe text color of the currently selected item in the spinner (ARGB format).
SPINNER_ICON_COLORSpinner icon color (ARGB format).
enum
ScaleType
enum

ScaleType

Package:dji.open.pilot.base.ui.model

Image scale type enumeration (used to indicate the ScaleType mode of an ImageView).

Enum Members

NameDescription
UNKNOWNUnknown scale type (default value or unrecognized value).
MATRIXUses a Matrix to control scaling and position.
FIT_XYStretches the image to match the view bounds (does not maintain the aspect ratio).
FIT_STARTScales the image to the view size while maintaining the aspect ratio, aligned to the top.
FIT_CENTERScales the image to the view size while maintaining the aspect ratio, centered.
FIT_ENDScales the image to the view size while maintaining the aspect ratio, aligned to the bottom.
CENTERDisplays the image at its original size and centered; the excess part is cropped.
CENTER_CROPCenters and scales the image to fill the view while maintaining the aspect ratio; it may be cropped.
CENTER_INSIDECenters and scales the image into the visible range while maintaining the aspect ratio, without cropping.

ViewType
enum

ViewType

Package:dji.open.pilot.base.ui.model

View type enumeration (identifies the UI component type of a remote view).

Enum Members

NameDescription
UNKNOWNUnknown view type (default value or unrecognized type).
TEXT_VIEWText view (displays static text content).
BUTTONButton control (supports click interaction operations).
TOGGLE_BUTTONToggle button (a button with two states: on/off).
SWITCHSwitch control (a component for visual state switching).
WEB_VIEWWeb view (used to render web page content).
EDIT_TEXTText edit box (supports user text input).
CHECK_BOXCheck box (a checkbox that supports multiple selections).
IMAGE_VIEWImage view (displays a bitmap or vector image).
PROGRESS_BARProgress bar (shows the task progress status).
LINEAR_LAYOUT_HORIZONTALHorizontal linear layout container (child views arranged horizontally).
LINEAR_LAYOUT_VERTICALVertical linear layout container (child views arranged vertically).
CONSTRAINT_LAYOUTConstraint layout container (supports complex constraint relationships).
SPINNERSpinner control (a dropdown list that supports single selection).
VERTICAL_LIST_VIEWVertical list view (a list control that supports vertical scrolling, with multiple built-in predefined item types).
CIRCULAR_PROGRESS_BARCircular progress bar (shows determinate progress in an arc form, supporting the PROGRESS / PROGRESS_COLOR / TEXT / TEXT_COLOR properties).
